title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 24. Rejects the ambition set out in the EDIS to achieve the defence readiness of the EU and its Member States and to boost the EDTIB, as well as the Commission’s proposal to establish a European defence industry programme (EDIP); stresses that the EU -programmes, such as the EDF, EDIRPA, ASAP and EDIP, which are intended to promote the build-up of European industrial sectors, violate Article 41(2) TEU and therefore need to be classified as illegal; opposes further militarisation of the EU and the further establishment of a military union as well as the continued support of the defence and arms industry
